army.line: And these streets, quiet as a sleeping army
stanza: I believe in the future we shall suffer no more
Maybe not in my lifetime but in yours, I feel sure
Sundogs barking at the break of dawn
Lightning pushes the edges of the thunderstorm
And these streets, quiet as a sleeping army
Send their battered dreams to heaven, to heaven

army.line: I gave my heart to the army
stanza: So happy I was invited
Gave me a reason to get out of the city
See you inside watchin' swarms on TV
Livin' and dyin' in New York, it means nothin' to me
I gave my heart to the army
The only sentimental thing I could think of
With cousins in colors and somewhere overseas
But it'll take a better war to kill a college man like me
Captain Kristofferson!
Buck Sergeant Newbury!
Leatherneck Jones!
Sergeant Cash!
What an Army!
What an Air Force!
What a Marines!
America!
I never served my country
America!
